# A year after the exhibition opening

Walked through the museum and listened to a harbour archive clip with a school group. The exhibition no longer occupies my working week. That is the intended result of finishing it. [[Exhibition plan]] records where the obligations went. It would be strange to treat the smaller number of new archive notes as evidence that the speakers ceased to matter.
